verification.disk_identity: Fresh full installed executable SHA256 matches canonical catalog
verification.prefixes: Each exact whole-instruction prefix matches disk .text and uniquely matches explicit imported program
verification.older: Only older_functions entries and previously retained independent contracts are qualified for the older profile; color/opacity prefixes omitted here remain unqualified

native_slate_brush_assign.abi: RCX initialized brush destination, RDX borrowed source, returns destination; native owning assignment, not memcpy

end_pie_image_slate_set_brush.abi: RCX Slate widget, RDX consuming pointer-attribute; source brush remains widget-owned

end_tiled_image_slate_set_brush.abi: RCX Slate widget, RDX consuming pointer-attribute; source brush remains widget-owned

end_tiled_image_synchronize.abi: void(widget*); rebuilds geometry and reevaluates other bindings; reentrancy/identity checks required

end_image_set_synchronize.abi: void(widget*); refreshes borrowed Images header and other properties/callback attributes; not a leaf operation

end_button_set_style.abi: RCX EndButton, RDX borrowed complete native ButtonStyle; owning assignment and persistent widget-owned Slate pointers

native_button_style_construct.abi: RCX storage, returns storage; native construction

native_button_style_assign.abi: RCX initialized destination, RDX borrowed source; native owning assignment

native_button_style_destroy.abi: RCX initialized native style; releases owners, not storage

native_slate_color_copy_construct.abi: RCX uninitialized destination, RDX borrowed source; retains shared controller; returns destination

native_slate_color_assign.abi: RCX initialized destination, RDX borrowed source; retain before release; returns destination

native_slate_color_destroy.abi: RCX initialized SlateColor; releases controller, does not free or zero storage

native_slate_invalidate.abi: RCX Slate widget, DL uint8 reason; native image refresh paths use reason 1

end_text_block_set_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; constant SlateColor through primary consuming setter

end_text_block_set_bottom_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; constant SlateColor through bottom consuming setter

end_image_set_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; directly changes primary alpha and refreshes Slate

end_pie_image_set_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; directly changes primary alpha and refreshes Slate

end_tiled_image_set_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; directly changes primary alpha and refreshes Slate

end_image_set_set_opacity.abi: RCX widget, XMM1 float; directly changes primary alpha and refreshes Slate

older_layout_verification.palette_abi: Same independently verified property fields/Slate pointers as default: nine borrowed LinearColor16 and two consuming SlateColor40; all six opacity inputs float in XMM1, widget RCX. Registered thunks are evidence routes, not direct widget/value entrypoints.
older_layout_verification.palette_opacity: Four image families directly store widget alpha at 0x1ac/0x1ac/0x1b4/0x124 and class-correct Slate refresh without color-setter calls. Text primary/bottom read effective shared color or stored color, replace alpha, call corresponding native consuming color setter; Ghidra's integer argument and apparent null widget are decompiler artifacts. Both text setters owning-assign via 0x141920828 and consume via 0x140aa4fa4.
older_layout_verification.source: Independently followed older native registered methods, constructors/vtables and reflection; every older_functions prefix instruction-complete and unique in older import only
older_layout_verification.ButtonStyle: size 0x278; owning brushes 0x08/0x90/0x118/0x1a0; Button style 0x120 and Slate 0x448
older_layout_verification.Pie: Brush 0x108, Slate 0x1f0, consuming 0x20 pointer attribute references permanent widget-owned brush
older_layout_verification.Tiled: Brush 0x110, Slate 0x208; vtable 0x1458d67f8 synchronization slot 0x2a8 (not default 0x2b0)
older_layout_verification.ImageSet: Images 0x108; Slate header 0x2b8; vtable 0x14582c738 synchronization slot 0x2a8 (not default 0x2b0)
older_layout_verification.dispatch: Use authenticated direct per-build synchronization targets, not a shared virtual offset; synchronization can reenter and is not a leaf refresh

SlateBrushTint.verification: Both metadata parameter records explicitly name SlateColor size 0x28; default 48-byte property record matches authenticated disk; older import only
SlateBrushTint.ownership: Native owning copy/assignment/destruction, never byte-copy owning TintColor

SlateColor.ownership: Native owning copy/assignment/destruction; consuming setter argument must not be destroyed twice

SlatePointerAttribute.initialization: zeroed storage; pointer must reference permanent widget-owned brush, not a temporary

EndTiledImage.preserve: tiling counts, spacing and dimensions; native synchronization rebuilds geometry and may reenter

EndImageSet.preserve: owning assign only entry brush; never replace array, transforms, pivots or native selected-index policy

EndButton.preserve: complete owning native style copy; preserve padding, sounds and all nonoverridden fields

animation.slow_binding: Native Set+PropertyName construction -> actual object function resolution -> NumParms>=1 -> cached weak setter -> ProcessEvent
animation.fast_offset: 0x1411deb84 rejects its simple offset optimization when Set<Property> exists
animation.concrete_fallback: Missing setter directly assigns SlateColor or directly stores LinearColor; arbitrary nested brush tint is not covered by setter interception
animation.custom_accessor_limit: 0x140e68be8 may select a registered custom accessor before slow binding; universal accessor coverage is not established
animation.policy: Instance/session-filtered native setters for proven class properties; preserve latest untinted native value, not just opening snapshot; no shared animation/asset mutation

MusicListCell.require: current strong ContentWidgets membership plus current index/generation/owner association, not an old pooled pointer

SpeedIcon.name: SpeedIcon
SpeedIcon.require: current strong row array membership then current row WidgetTree, complete header/member/tree rereads; preserve native 2/1/0 state policy
